brief: 7 lies you still believe about digital marketing in 2026.

slots.headline: Seven lies you still believe about digital marketing
slots.swipeNote: Swipe to see the 7 lies brands still believe

slots.title: More followers equals more revenue
slots.body: A massive audience means nothing if engagement is low. Focus on community value instead of vanity metrics.

slots.title: SEO died because of AI search
slots.body: Generative AI has changed search behavior, not eliminated it. Optimized content still drives qualified organic traffic daily.

slots.title: You must post content every day
slots.body: Consistency matters more than overwhelming frequency. Three thoughtful posts a week outperform daily noise every time.

slots.title: Only paid ads can scale brands
slots.body: Organic storytelling builds trust that paid media cannot buy. Smart brands balance both for sustainable long-term growth.

slots.title: TikTok is just for Gen Z
slots.body: User demographics are broadening rapidly across every age group. Your ideal customer is already scrolling right now.

slots.title: Data alone reveals the full truth
slots.body: Numbers show what happened, but not always why. Human intuition and creativity still drive breakthrough marketing campaigns.

slots.quote: The best strategy is the truth
slots.headline: Ready to rethink your marketing plan
slots.author: The VANTAGE Team
